item.title: Mikaela Shiffrin drops F-bomb, talks celebrating gold with espresso martini
item.description: A day after dropping one of the most dominant gold-medal winning performances in Olympic slalom history, American star Mikaela Shiffrin dropped an F-bomb while describing the victory — an on-air slip she joked may have been influenced by the espresso martini she drank in her post-race celebration.

item.title: From the sports desk: Two golden moments on the ice
item.description: Hello from Milan and Cortina, where American figure skater Alysa Liu summed up today’s events quite succinctly.

item.title: Women's hockey star Hilary Knight sets all-time U.S. goal-scoring record
item.description: U.S. hockey star Hilary Knight became the all-time leading scorer in U.S. women's hockey history at the Olympics in the most dramatic way possible when she scored her 15th career goal late in the gold medal game of the Milan Cortina Olympics.

item.title: Amber Glenn finishes just off the podium after a high-scoring free skate
item.description: Amber Glenn didn’t expect to be in medal contention after a disappointing short program earlier this week at the Olympics.

item.title: Figure skater Alysa Liu wins gold for Team USA, ending 20-year medal drought
item.description: Alysa Liu won Olympic gold in women’s singles, the first gold medal for Team USA in the event since 2002. Team USA’s women’s hockey team also won gold, beating their Canadian rivals in a thrilling come-from-behind win. NBC News’ Stephanie Gosk reports.

item.title: Family of Virginia Roberts Giuffre calls arrest of former Prince Andrew 'surreal'
item.description: The family of Virginia Roberts Giuffre spoke with NBC News' Hallie Jackson about their reaction to the arrest of former Prince Andrew, calling it "surreal" and a "piece of justice" Virginia had been fighting for.

item.title: Clintons scheduled to give House Oversight testimony
item.description: Former President Bill Clinton and former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton are set to testify to the House Oversight Committee next week for its investigation into Jeffrey Epstein, a committee spokeswoman said

item.title: How the Andrew-Epstein saga plunged Britain's royals into a yearslong crisis
item.description: LONDON — The arrest of Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor on suspicion of misconduct in public office is the latest development in a yearslong saga over his dealings with convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein, which has plunged the British monarchy into its biggest crisis in decades

item.title: Information sharing between DOJ and U.K. officials is complex — and not required
item.description: Police leaders in the United Kingdom have said they are in touch with overseas law enforcement about millions of documents released by the Justice Department related to the investigation into Jeffrey Epstein, but sharing such information between different countries is time-consuming and complex.

item.title: Former Prince Andrew arrested in UK
item.description: Former Prince Andrew has been released from custody after being arrested on suspicion of conduct in public office, connected to his years of friendship with Jeffrey Epstein. NBC News’ Raf Sanchez has the story.
